name: Weddings
overview: Scripture reveals that marriage is a divine institution established by God from the beginning, designed for companionship and unity, as seen in Genesis where God creates a suitable helper for man and commands that a man shall leave his parents to become one flesh with his wife. Jesus affirms this original design of male and female created by God, highlighting the sacredness of the marital bond. Additionally, the value of partnership is emphasized in Ecclesiastes, illustrating that two are better than one for mutual benefit. These verses collectively underscore the God-ordained purpose and unity central to weddings.
